FranchisingPage.p1_1: Grillado’s™ Head Office will ensure the success of each location by offering our franchisees a
FranchisingPage.p2_1: Our restaurants are built on a reliable, proven system designed to ensure the quality of our food, brand image, and performance of every Grillado’s™ location. Our operations are simple to manage and require no prior restaurant experience—only a passion for delivering a great dining experience. We provide field consultants, regional representatives, and a comprehensive training program to ensure our franchisees and restaurant managers are capable of running daily operations at every Grillado’s™. Our support team will equip you with the manuals, guidance, and training necessary to ensure total competency.
FranchisingPage.p3: We are committed to the continuous growth and expansion of the Grillado’s™ brand. Our team remains consistently focused on innovative methods to promote and elevate the Grillado’s™ name.
FranchisingPage.step1_desc: Our franchise application form can be found at www.grillados.ca. The information provided in our application form will be used exclusively by Grillado's Franchising Inc. for the purpose of assessing the applicant's eligibility as a future franchisee.
FranchisingPage.step2_desc: Once the application has been received and reviewed, you will be informed of our interest and an interview will be scheduled.
FranchisingPage.step3_desc: We will require a statement of net worth.
FranchisingPage.step4_desc: A Franchise Information Document (FID) will present essential information regarding the proposed franchise opportunity. The FID will contain all the details relating to Grillado's Franchising Inc.
FranchisingPage.step5_desc: Grillado's team will assist in site selection to find the best options for both the Franchisor and Franchisee.
FranchisingPage.step6_desc: We will design and build your store.
FranchisingPage.step7_desc: We will provide the franchisee with 4 to 6 weeks of training before opening. With the exception of travel expenses, the cost of the training is fully covered by the franchisor.
FranchisingPage.step8_desc: The Grillado's™ team will provide you with full support during the opening of your new store.

FranchiseFAQ.heading: Franchise Q&A
FranchiseFAQ.q1: How much will it cost to build-out my store?
FranchiseFAQ.a1: It depends on the size of the store, equipment needed for the concept, décor chosen and the existing condition of the premises. The total investment for a new build-out from a 2,000 to 3,000 square foot space can range from $500,000 to $600,000.
FranchiseFAQ.q2: What is The Recommended Location Size?
FranchiseFAQ.a2: First we establish what is the best fit for your business goals. The standard sit concept has 60 to 80 seats can range from 2,000 to 3,000 square feet.
FranchiseFAQ.q3: How Much is The Franchise Fee?
FranchiseFAQ.a3: The Grillado’s™ franchise fee per location is $40,000 for a ten (10) year term. Each renewal term is 50% of the franchise fee at the current time of renewal.
FranchiseFAQ.q4: How Long is The Initial Franchise Agreement?
FranchiseFAQ.a4: The Franchise Agreement is a ten-year (10) term.
FranchiseFAQ.q5: Can We Renew Our Franchise Agreement?
FranchiseFAQ.a5: Yes, each renewal term can be either five (5) or ten (10) years or in between depending on your lease agreement.
FranchiseFAQ.q6: Is Training Included As Part Of The Franchise Fee?
FranchiseFAQ.a6: Yes, a compulsory and comprehensive eight (8) to twelve (12) weeks training program is scheduled prior to the opening of your franchise. We will train your staff prior to opening and assign someone from head office to help you when you first open your restaurant. We will remain on longer should additional training be deemed necessary by our corporate training team. The cost of airfare and accommodations while in Montreal is at your own expense. Miscellaneous expenses during that time period are also the responsibility of the franchisee. Training by our team at your store that requires lodging and transportation are additional costs of the franchisee.
FranchiseFAQ.q7: How Much Are The Royalty Fees?
FranchiseFAQ.a7: A monthly royalty fee of 5% of your Gross Revenue is payable to the Franchisor.
FranchiseFAQ.q8: Who Is Responsible For Finding The Location And Negotiating The Lease?
FranchiseFAQ.a8: Grillado’s™ Head Office will assist the franchisee in identifying a high-potential location that is suitable to both the franchisee and Grillado’s Brand. As a franchisee, if Grillado’s™ is not on the head lease you are ultimately responsible for the negotiating of the final lease.
FranchiseFAQ.q9: If We Don't Have A Location, Will Grillado's™ Find Us One?
FranchiseFAQ.a9: Grillado’s™ has a broad range of relationships with established Commercial Real Estate Firms in a variety of geographical markets. We are happy to introduce you to our network and help you to find a location. Grillado’s™ is committed in assisting the franchisee in every way possible in identifying a high-potential location.
FranchiseFAQ.q10: How Much Profit Will I Make? What Is The ROI?
FranchiseFAQ.a10: There are several factors that will contribute to your level of success. The following two are critical: the location you have chosen and the ability to maintain daily operating cost (maintaining food cost and target salaries). In accordance with franchise laws, we are unable to provide specific information pertaining to profit or ROI. Grillado’s™ will be able to provide you with information on projected expenses and costs that will assist you in developing your own projections for revenue and potential earnings.
FranchiseFAQ.a11: Once you are a Franchisee of Record, Grillado’s™ can assist you with the financing application to a commercial lender or bank. The franchisee is ultimately responsible for providing the required funding to develop the Grillado’s™ franchise.
FranchiseFAQ.q12: How Long Will It Take To Build A Grillado's™ Restaurant?
FranchiseFAQ.a12: Once a location is secured, and construction permit issued, it takes approximately nine (9) to twelve (12) weeks for the construction of a Grillado’s™ location.
FranchiseFAQ.q13: Where Is Grillado's™ Offering The Opportunity To Open Franchises?
FranchiseFAQ.a13: We are currently franchising in Canada, and are open to expansion with experienced retailers in the USA and Internationally.
FranchiseFAQ.q14: Where Do I Buy Equipment And Supplies?
FranchiseFAQ.a14: All equipment and supplies are purchased from the franchisor’s trusted and approved vendors.
